Failure.Title: Nura Wallet could not start
Failure.Message: Your wallet is still on this device. Reloading usually clears this.

Missing.Title: This screen does not exist
Missing.Message: Nothing was lost. Your wallet is still on this device.

Connect.Message: Connect to the world of decentralized applications and finance.

Decentralized.Message: Gives you full control over your digital assets and allows you to interact with dApps.

Secure.Message: Using advanced security protocols to protect your digital assets and personal information.

ImportWallet.Title: Import Existing Wallet
ImportWallet.Subtitle: Restore your wallet from a seed phrase or private key
ImportWallet.Agreement: I understand my password cannot be recovered
ImportWallet.KeyNote: A private key restores only the account it belongs to. A seed phrase restores every account of the wallet.
ImportWallet.PasteHint: Paste the whole phrase into any box to fill them all.
ImportWallet.ErrorMissingWords: Enter every word of the phrase
ImportWallet.ErrorWordCount: A recovery phrase has 12 or 24 words
ImportWallet.ErrorLength: Password must be between 6 and 32 characters
ImportWallet.ErrorGenerate: Failed to import wallet. Please try again

CreateWallet.Title: Create New Wallet
CreateWallet.Subtitle: Set up your secure wallet to get started
CreateWallet.Agreement: I understand my password cannot be recovered
CreateWallet.ErrorLength: Password must be between 6 and 32 characters
CreateWallet.ErrorGenerate: Failed to generate wallet. Please try again

Unlock.Title: Unlock Wallet
Unlock.Subtitle: Enter your password to open your wallet
Unlock.Recovery: If you forget your password, you will not be able to recover it.
Unlock.ErrorMissing: Wallet data could not be loaded
Unlock.BiometricGone: Biometric unlock was turned off because the biometrics on this device changed. Enter your password.
Unlock.BiometricFailed: Could not unlock with biometrics. Enter your password.

Offline.Title: No internet connection
Offline.Message: Balances update when the connection returns.

Accounts.Title: Accounts
Accounts.Subtitle: Switch between accounts of this wallet
Accounts.IndexNote: Each index derives a different account from the same recovery phrase.
Accounts.SingleNote: This wallet was imported from a private key, so it has a single account.
Accounts.ErrorIndex: Enter a whole number between %s and %s
Accounts.ErrorExists: That index is already in your list
Accounts.RemoveConfirm: Remove %s from this list? You can add it back later with the same derivation index.

Tokens.Title: Tokens
Tokens.ContractHint: Paste the token contract address. Its symbol and decimals are read from the contract.
Tokens.NotFound: No ERC20 token found at this address on this network
Tokens.Exists: This token is already in your list
Tokens.RemoveConfirm: Stop tracking %s? Your balance is not affected and you can add the token again at any time.

Network.Title: Network
Network.Name: Network name
Network.Invalid: Please fill in the network name and symbol
Network.InvalidRpc: RPC URL must start with http
Network.InvalidChainId: Chain ID must be a positive number
Network.RemoveConfirm: Remove %s? Its RPC endpoints are not stored anywhere else, so you would need to enter them again.

Send.Title: Send
Send.Offline: You need an internet connection to send.
Send.Reserved: The network fee has been kept aside, so this amount can actually be sent.
Send.ScanHint: Point the camera at the recipient's QR code.
Send.ScanDenied: Camera access was refused. Allow the camera for this app and try again.
Send.ScanMissing: No camera was found on this device.
Send.ScanUnavailable: The camera could not be opened.
Send.ScanInvalid: This code does not contain a wallet address.
Send.ScanNetwork: This code is for a different network.

Receive.Title: Receive
Receive.Scan: Scan to receive %s on this network
Receive.QrFailed: The QR code could not be drawn. The address below still works.

Redeem.Title: Redeem
Redeem.Info: You can get a redeem code from ashbringer.org.
Redeem.Success: %s USDT will be sent to this address
Redeem.SuccessNote: Payouts are sent by hand, so it can take a little while to arrive.
Redeem.SuccessSlow: The shop has not been notified yet, so the transfer may take longer than usual.
Redeem.ErrorInvalid: Check the code and try again
Redeem.ErrorUnknown: This code is not valid or has not been sold yet
Redeem.ErrorUsed: This code has already been redeemed
Redeem.ErrorBusy: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
Redeem.ErrorCode: That does not look like a valid redeem code
Redeem.ErrorFailed: Could not redeem this code. Try again later.

Activity.Title: Transaction History
Activity.Unavailable: This network's explorer could not provide the history.
Activity.Offline: History cannot be loaded while offline.

Browser.Title: Browser
Browser.FavoriteEmpty: Sites you keep will be listed here.
Browser.RecentEmpty: Sites you open will be listed here.
Browser.ViewNote: Desktop asks sites for their full layout. It applies to the next page you open.
Browser.CacheNote: Only the icons shown here. Pages you visit keep their own cache, which the wallet cannot reach.
Browser.Hint: This build cannot embed a real browser, so websites that refuse framing will stay blank.
Browser.ConnectedNote: Connected sites can read your address and ask you to sign. They can never move funds without your approval.

Swap.Title: Swap
Swap.Failed: The swap did not go through.
Swap.NoPool: There is no pool for this pair yet.
Swap.Unsupported: %s trades only with WNURA here. Wrap it to WNURA first, then swap the WNURA.
Swap.FeeShort: Not enough %s left to pay the network fee.

Biometric.Title: Biometric unlock
Biometric.Note: Enter your wallet password to unlock with your face or fingerprint from now on. Your recovery phrase will still ask for the password.
Biometric.ErrorUnavailable: Biometric unlock is not available in this build of the app.
Biometric.ErrorFailed: Biometric unlock could not be turned on. Try again.

Request.InsecureNote: This site doesn't use a secure connection. Anyone on the network could have changed what it is asking for.
Request.ConnectNote: This site is asking to see your account address and balance. It cannot move anything without asking you again.
Request.SignatureNote: Sign only messages you understand. A signature can prove who you are, and it can also authorise an action.
Request.TypedNote: Read the data below before signing. A signature of this kind can let a contract spend your tokens.
Request.TransactionNote: This sends a transaction from your account. It cannot be undone.
Request.ChainNote: This site is asking the wallet to change network. Balances and history will change with it.
Request.AssetNote: This site is asking the wallet to track a token. The details are read from the contract, not from the site.
Request.MicrophoneNote: This site is asking to listen through this device's microphone. It stays allowed for this site until you lock the wallet.
Request.GasLimitInvalid: Enter a whole number from 21000 to 100000000.
Request.GasPriorityInvalid: Enter a tip of zero or more, no higher than the max fee.
Request.GasLimitLow: This is below the estimate of %s. The transaction may fail, and the fee is still paid.
Request.AllowanceNote: This does not move anything now. It lets the spender below take %s of %s from your account later, at any time, until you revoke it.
Request.AllowanceNoteUnlimited: This does not move anything now. It lets the spender below take any amount of %s from your account later, at any time, until you revoke it.

Phrase.Title: Recovery Phrase
Phrase.Warning: Anyone who sees these words can take everything in this wallet. Write them down offline and never share them.
Phrase.WarningKey: Anyone who sees this key can take everything in this wallet. Keep it offline and never share it.
Phrase.ErrorMissing: Could not read the recovery phrase
Phrase.ErrorMissingKey: Could not read the private key
Phrase.ExportDanger: Saving your phrase outside the app is dangerous. Photo galleries sync to the cloud and any app with media or storage access can read these files. Move the backup somewhere offline and delete the copy as soon as you have.
Phrase.ExportSavedImage: Saved to Pictures/Nura Wallet. Delete it once your backup is safe.
Phrase.ExportSavedText: Saved to Downloads. Delete it once your backup is safe.
Phrase.ExportUnsupported: This device is too old to save files this way
Phrase.ExportImageWarning: Anyone with these words owns the wallet. Keep offline.

Backup.Message: Have you backed up your recovery phrase? It is the only way to restore this wallet if you lose this device or forget your password.
Backup.MessageKey: Have you backed up your private key? It is the only way to restore this wallet if you lose this device or forget your password.

Delete.Title: Delete Wallet
Delete.Message: This deletes the wallet from this device, along with its accounts, tokens, connected sites and browsing history. Your funds stay on the blockchain, and only your recovery phrase can restore them. Without it, they are lost for good.
Delete.MessageKey: This deletes the wallet from this device, along with its accounts, tokens, connected sites and browsing history. Your funds stay on the blockchain, and only your private key can restore them. Without it, they are lost for good.
